integrity_notes: The period formula and asymptotics are derived analytically from the published half-plane orbit equations. Numerical spot checks are corroborative only. A related 2026 period-function paper was inspected at abstract level only, leaving a residual priority risk.
scientific_limitations: The exact period law applies to the normalized linear-quadratic canonical system only; the limiting endpoint at kappa=-1 is not a nontrivial cycle, and the endpoint kappa=0 is unbounded. No stability or perturbation theorem is claimed.
title: Exact Lambert-W period law for an unbounded piecewise linear-quadratic pseudo-center
